cases.description: Thirty-four headings of punctuation alone have empty slugs, so none has a derived anchor (decision C14); GitHub gives the first 33 the anchors `""` and `-1` to `-32`, and the last no permalink.
A heading of a hyphen or an underscore alone keeps it (step 5): `## -` gives `-`.
A heading of a hyphen or an underscore alone keeps it (step 5): `## _` gives `_`.
